newsitem.title: USA: Jos. A. Bank Q1 sales $38.7 mln vs $36.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Jos. A. Bank Q1 sales $38.7 mln vs $36.4 mln.

text.p: Jos. A. Bank Clothiers Inc said Wednesday that total retail and catalog sales for the first quarter ended May 3 increased 6.2 percent to $38.7 million from $36.4 million in the same period last year.
The company said increases in sales reflect a 15 percent rise in existing markets where three new stores were opened.
Comparable store sales decreased by 1.5 percent because of the sales increase attributable to the new stores opened in existing markets, and an aggressive promotional campaign during April 1996.
In addition, the company said catalog sales increased by 40 percent during the quarter with an increase of approximately 20 percent in mailings.
